scope: Computer Use observations of the real product settings dialog with isolated data, plus saved-file checks

checks.name: both independent controls and explanatory text are visible without clipping
both learning controls default to enabled
clicking word learning off preserves the English checkbox
reopening restores word learning off and English learning on
changing word learning then cancelling leaves the stored settings unchanged
test dialog was closed after verification

limits: One current desktop scale; not a multi-monitor settings test
No installed TSF activation or system input settings changes
